slides.texte_overlay:
5 daily habits for a
healthier mind

sunlight before screens

get ten minutes of daylight before you look at any screen. morning light sets your body clock, lifts your mood and makes falling asleep easier at night.

a real conversation

have one real conversation every day, in person or on the phone. human connection protects your mind in ways no screen, video or podcast can ever fully replace.

a calm daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day learning something calm and beautiful: a constellation, a painting, a myth. a mind with gentle things to think about has less room for worry.
slides.texte_sophia:
a calm daily lesson

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something calm and beautiful: a constellation, a painting. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and my mind has less room for worry.

slides.texte_overlay:
moving your body

walk, stretch or dance for at least twenty minutes every day. movement is one of the most reliable mood lifters there is, and it works within minutes.

a gentle evening

dim the lights and put your phone away an hour before bed. a slow evening tells your brain the day is over, and better sleep follows almost every time.
